**Decided here — F76 home.** The check lives in defineGraceCommand next to refuseBooleanSpaceForm, reading rawArgs against that command's args def. It is flag-only: a token that starts with a dash, including equals form; scan stops at a bare double-dash terminator the same way the boolean guard does. Accepted tokens are the declared arg names, citty kebab aliases, declared short aliases, boolean no- forms, and citty builtin help and version tokens. Positionals are not inspected.
**Parent-run skip.** When the command has subCommands and the first non-flag rawArgs token is a key of those subCommands, skip the check. citty then runs the parent after a successful child, and the parent rawArgs still hold the child flags (measured). A check that ran against an empty parent args def would reject valid invocations.
**Class coverage.** Every liveCommandRoots entry is produced by defineGraceCommand (branded). review, doctor, and gate convert; verdict wraps because gate wraps. defineGraceCommand on an already-branded def does not double-wrap (gate approve / apply / archive are already branded). Root ngrace is also wrapped so an undeclared flag at the root names that flag instead of only No command specified.
**Usage.** Throw GraceCommandError invalid-arguments. The message names the first unrecognized token as typed and appends citty renderUsage of this command (leaf when a leaf was dispatched; parent when no sub was). Text: that message on stderr. JSON: the existing envelope; error.message carries the same text; no new envelope key (RM-GOVERNED-PATH D13). Exit code comes from the error (1). Do not throw citty CLIError: that bypasses runGraceCommand and undoes F25.
The unknown-flag refusal and a valid parent-plus-child invocation (module show with argv token path) must be able to fail alone (F68).
